title: Binary decrement specification
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, if the decrement operation is undefined, then $w$ consists entirely of false entries. If it returns a word $v$, then $v$ has the same length as $w$, the binary value of $w$ is one more than the binary value of $v$, and $v$ has one fewer true entry than $w$ plus the length of the initial run of false entries in $w$.
